cohort: Women undergoing their first or second elective cesarean section
finding: Cortisol levels were statistically lower at all time points in women undergoing their second elective cesarean section compared to those undergoing their first, suggesting that a second elective cesarean section generates a less stressful response.
mod_finding: This study compares the stress response during elective cesarean sections for the first and second time, finding that a second elective cesarean section generates a significantly less stressful response than the first.
